sourceRefs.heading: ## Ordinary spells: one explicit test configuration

independentReset: This diagnostic begins independently from the qualified main supporting actor after its disclosed -1 paid cast. It does not execute the main case or append a recast to any existing branch. No damage, other spell, rest, encounter boundary or source-qualified family reset is supplied before the later ordinary turn.

components.F: ordinary reusable held class focus; its numeric enhancements are not assumed

initialActor.lifeContext: A specified player-character sheet fixture, not a new rated monster; unlisted optional features are not active. Bound automatic class features remain operative at their actual triggers.
initialActor.ArcaneWardResistance: force: Divination specialization, no actual prepared damaging Divination alternative in this fixture.
initialActor.initialSetup: At-1 paid actual Dimensional Anchor Action7RP24->17, first prepared family D0, V/S/F, rank4 Abjuration spell legitimately acquired at Wizard7. Chosen specialization is Divination, so no Abjuration passive buffer. Concentration source deadline59. SAME-ENCOUNTER QUALIFICATION RD8-LOCAL70-01: this disclosed paid cast at -1 belongs to the same actual encounter as the current case; its dimensional-anchor prepared-family exemption is already spent. There is no intervening encounter boundary, rest or source-qualified history reset. Crossing the fixture time0 is not a reset. The correct first cast still generated zero base Dissonance; the existing RP17, Dissonance0, previousSpell, Refrain0 and original deadline59 are unchanged. Independent branch overrides of the field's current existence or recipient do not by themselves undo that prior paid casting record.
initialActor.pathQualification: Wizard Hero selection begins at class level10; no Spellbinder feature is acquired at7.
